scripts.format: npm run format:templates && npm run format:translations && npm run format:assets && npm run format:php
scripts.format:php: prettier --write "app/**/*.php" "bootstrap/*.php" "config/**/*.php" "database/**/*.php" "routes/**/*.php" "tests/**/*.php" && php vendor/bin/pint app bootstrap/app.php bootstrap/providers.php config database routes tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "resources/views/**/*.blade.php" "lang/**/*.php" "resources/css/**/*.css" "resources/js/**/*.js" vite.config.js package.json && php vendor/bin/pint --test app bootstrap/app.php bootstrap/providers.php config database routes tests
